# HR Benefits and Compensation Optimization Plan

This document highlights critical areas requiring immediate attention and optimization within the Human Resources department:

*   Optimize medical insurance quarterly.
*   Investigate career development urgently.
*   Review the bonus structure for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the annual leave urgently.
*   Update the bonus structure quarterly.
